name: pixel-forge
description: PixelForge - A local-first media toolkit. Compress, transform, and forge your images with ease.

scripts.start: npm run server:dev & npm run client:dev
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.build:vercel: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.bootstrap: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
